card.name: Linking words before a condition or organism
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, in, by, certain and developing, right before a disease, organism or susceptible group in antibiotic label text. Also the colon or space in Bible verse references like 2 Thess. 2:3.

modes.label: Linking word in label text
modes.description: A short word like of, in or by that comes just before a named infection, organism or at-risk group.
modes.example: DIFICID should only be used for the treatment<< of>> C. difficile -associated diarrhea.

modes.label: Scripture verse numbers
modes.description: The colon or space between chapter and verse in a Bible citation.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the name of an infection, germ or susceptible group, and on chapter-verse separators in Bible citations.
